articles.title: The late Tom Parker’s wife, Kelsey Parker, welcomes baby
articles.summary: With hearts full of joy, Kelsey Parker, the widow of the late singer Tom Parker, has announced the birth of her baby boy, River, alongside her partner Will Lindsay. This beautiful moment comes after a painful stillbirth last year and follows their pregnancy reveal earlier in May.

articles.title: 'I don't think witnessing one's wife's death is a blessing': Vinod
articles.summary: Actor Vinod Kozhikode opened up about the heartbreaking final moments spent with his wife, sharing his profound sorrow. He vividly remembers noticing her irregular breathing before his morning walk.
